speaker_name: Dr. Hafidh Muhammad Abid Yusuf (Qari Adil)
youtube_description:
ABOUT THE SPEAKER: 

Shaykh Dr. Mohammed Abid Yusuf began his Islamic studies under the tutelage of his father Shaykhul Hadith Maulana Yusuf Kothi (Student of the great Muhaddith, Shaykh Sayyid Fakhruddin Muradabadi d.1972).

In his teens, he travelled to Damascus and Cairo to further his Qur'an and Arabic studies, studying under Shaykh Basheer Araksousi, Shaykh Samih Nenaai and gaining an ijazah in Hafs an Asim from the Shaykhul Qurra of Syria, Shaykh al Muqri' Muhyiddin al Kurdi d.2012.

As his day job, he works as a Rheumatologist in Essex.

Shaykh Dr. Mohammed Abid Yusuf began his Islamic studies under the tutelage of his father Shaykhul Hadith Maulana Yusuf Kothi (Student of the great Muhaddith, Shaykh Sayyid Fakhruddin Muradabadi d.1972).

In his teens, he travelled to Damascus and Cairo to further his Qur'an and Arabic studies, studying under Shaykh Basheer Araksousi, Shaykh Samih Nenaai and gaining an ijazah in Hafs an Asim from the Shaykhul Qurra of Syria, Shaykh al Muqri' Muhyiddin al Kurdi d.2012.

As his day job, he works as a Rheumatologist in Essex.
